Unlimited tasks

Tasks are to-do items that show who needs to do what by when.

Unlimited projects

Projects help you organize related tasks into a single space with different views like lists, boards, or timelines so you can see the big picture.

Unlimited comments

Comments let you and your team discuss tasks directly within each task, keeping all communication centered where the work happens.

Unlimited storage, 100MB per file

Store an unlimited number of files, each up to 100MB in size, directly within Asana.

Unlimited messages

Send direct messages and have team conversations in Asana to keep discussions all in one place instead of scattered across email and chat apps.

Activity logs

Asana activity logs automatically track important changes to a task, giving teams visibility into task history and accountability.

iOS and Android mobile apps

Asana offers desktop apps for macOS and Windows for optimal performance, plus iOS and Android apps for managing work on the go.

Recurring tasks

Set up recurring tasks that automatically generate the next instance with updated due dates when you complete them.

Multi-select and bulk actions

Select multiple tasks at once to perform bulk actions like editing or deleting.

Multi-home tasks to projects

With multi-homing, you can add the same task to multiple projects and any updates to that task sync automatically across all instances.

Tables

Keep your information where the work is. Lookup fields pull details into projects, so you stop switching tools.

AI Teammates and Asana Dash

Put 30+ AI Teammates to work, each with the right skills for the job and context from your work. Asana Dash routes work to the right Teammate and surfaces what’s next.

Frequently asked questions about task management tools

An AI request is one successful unit of work executed by AI Teammates or Asana Dash, which share a single pool of AI requests. Administrative tasks in Dash are included at no extra cost. You're only charged when work gets done; failed, timed-out, or canceled tasks don't count. For Dash, AI requests only count when Dash completes complex work (e.g., integrations, web search, long-form content generation) or hands off the work to an AI Teammate.

Paid usage packs are valid for your entire billing cycle. For monthly customers: packs expire at month's end. For annual customers: packs can be used anytime across your contract term with no monthly resets. On-demand, pay-as-you-go billing is also available, billed monthly for exactly what you used with no upfront commitment.

You have two options. Prepaid usage packs at $0.50 per request, valid for your full billing cycle. On-demand, pay-as-you-go billing at $0.60 per request, billed monthly in arrears.

Your admin console shows a live dashboard of requests consumed, remaining balance, and usage by user and AI Teammate. Alerts fire at 65%, 85%, and 100% of your allotment. Admins can set a spending cap on on-demand billing and toggle AI request access per user at any time.

You can cancel at any time, and if you cancel before your next renewal, you'll retain access to paid features through the end of your current subscription period. To cancel your paid plan, log in to your Asana account and access your admin console.

Asana offers flexible subscription options based on the features you need and the size of your team. For smaller teams, we have plans designed for 2 members.

AI Studio is available on Starter, Advanced, Enterprise, and Enterprise+ plans. AI Studio is available in three options:

  • AI Studio Basic: Included access to AI Studio to explore how AI can help take on routine, manual work (includes rate limits).

  • AI Studio Plus: Paid access to AI Studio to level up productivity for individuals and small teams (available on monthly & annual plans).

  • AI Studio Pro: Paid access to AI Studio to scale complex workflows and business operations with advanced billing controls (available on an annual plan).

To get started, ensure your admin has Asana AI enabled. From there, all members of your domain will be able to build smart workflows. Learn more here.

You can grow your team by adding seats in increments as follows:

  • Between 2 and 5 total users: add seats in increments of 1

  • Up to 30 total users: add seats in increments of 5

  • Up to 100 total users: add seats in increments of 10

  • Up to 500 total users: add seats in increments of 25

  • More than 500 users: add seats in increments of 50

Privacy Preference Center

When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences, or your device, and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect. The information does not usually identify you directly, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to learn more and change our default settings. Blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.

Manage Consent Preferences

Strictly Necessary Cookies

Always Active

These cookies are strictly necessary to provide you with certain features. For example, these cookies allow you to access secure areas that require registration and set your privacy preferences. Because these cookies are essential to providing services to you, they cannot be disabled. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but it may cause some parts of the site to not work.

Performance Cookies

These cookies allow us or our third-party analytics providers to collect information and statistics on use of our services by you and other visitors. This information helps us to improve our services and products for the benefit of you and others.

Functional Cookies

These cookies provide enhanced functionality, providing chat support, allowing you to more easily complete forms, personalizing content to your preferences, and selecting your communications preferences. If you do not enable these cookies, or choose to disable them in the future, that could impact your ability to use certain features.

Targeting Cookies

These cookies, provided by our third-party advertising partners, collect information about your browsing habits, as well as your preferences for various features and services. They also provide us with auditing, research, and reporting to know when advertising content has been displayed and how successful the content has been. This information allows us and our third-party advertising providers to display relevant advertising content.
